items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: But I think Hosey was the best manager he had because Hosey put a band with him and sort of handled his affairs.

ctx.x: But the band didn't have a baritone. I heard a lot of descriptions about Slim's personality.

Well Slim, he was not intelligent. He was sort of like a person that would come up on the phone. But he wasn't. The most harm, the most harm he did was himself. He drank a lot. I believe that's what killed him. He drank heavily. And he was, a lot of people made money off him because he didn't have the right manager. I mean everybody was trying to see how much they could get out of it. But I think Hosey was the best manager he had because Hosey put a band with him and sort of handled his affairs. It was wild…
